rationale:
Strengths: The agent verified the user via email, viewed the user’s orders with read-only tools, correctly identified the delivered speaker that was more expensive and not water-resistant, asked for explicit confirmation before initiating the return, and successfully requested the return to the original payment method. For the laptop change, the agent listed available 13-inch options, then clearly stated the exact proposed change (to the 13-inch i5, 16GB/512GB space grey) and obtained explicit confirmation before modifying the pending order. The modification and additional charge matched tool data.

Issue leading to fail: The agent stated, both before and after the modification, that no further changes or cancellations can be made to the order. This restriction is not supported by any tool output or the policy summary provided. Making such an unsupported claim constitutes fabricated/unsupported information, violating the requirement to provide correct final information. Although the agent’s actions (return and modification) were otherwise correct and confirmed, this unsupported statement fails the pass bar.
